mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect clear skies around Badger Prairie County Park and a beautiful Waning Gibbous moon later. If you look up at 5:51 PM, you will see the International Space Station passing high in the sky, moving from the northwest near Verona High School toward the southeast near Festival Foods.

City Hall reminds residents that information packets for the 2027 spring election are now available. All four Aldermanic District seats are on the ballot, and candidates must submit their Declaration of Candidacy and nomination papers by 5:00 p.m. on January 5, 2027.

There is plenty to do in Verona! Today, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run or head to the Wisconsin Brewing Company for their 50th-anniversary craft brewing party. Tomorrow, check out the Crafty Fair at ART House 360 or catch more live music at Paddy Mac's.
Looking at recent reports, on November 3, officers responded to a domestic disturbance on Prairie Way Boulevard which resulted in an arrest for intimidation and disorderly conduct.
It is a great day to stop by Culver's for the flavor of the day, Snickers Swirl. The restaurant is currently open and will be serving until 10:30 PM tonight.
